note: Former Portsmouth Speedway (1952-1962) off US-52 near Shawnee State Forest; the old oval track circles most of the seasonal sites, and a row of creek sites backs onto Turkey Creek. --Claude
summary: Fees confirmed $40 (full hookup and creek W/E sites) with weekly/monthly/seasonal terms; water+sewer confirmed, pull-throughs confirmed; cleared note-derived 50-amp, 72-ft max and 'not year-round' (operator silent); added showers/dump/laundry/wifi. Note trimmed: dropped site count range, hookups, rig length, 'Open Apr-Oct' and the RV Life rating line (all fields or unconfirmed), added where the seasonal and creek sites are. Pin 270 m off.
flags: Private gate facts: posted rate $40 a night (operator's own page, current); not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false from the directory); nearest gateway none within 40 km (Cincinnati 132 km); family has not stayed. Presence passes: working website with phone (740) 858-2409; Google Maps 4.3 stars from 83 reviews, same phone. Online booking: none found (phone/email).

Long-stay character, a human call (tests 4/5): the operator says the old oval 'circles around the majority of our seasonal camp sites', sells seasonal contracts April 1-October 31 and contract-worker sites at $550/month for up to 6 months; winter imagery shows roughly 60 RVs parked in and around the oval. But a nightly rate is posted ($40, test 2 passes), pull-through and creek sites are offered nightly, and recent Google reviews are transient stays: 'Stayed here for a night while attending a local family party. Owner was accommodating with a pull through site' (about a month ago, 4/5); 'Nice and quiet, family oriented with friendly owner' (about 3 months ago, vacation). The number of sites sold nightly is not published, so test 4 (1 in 10) can't be measured from the operator's pages.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront): the operator advertises 'Creek sites' and says 'drop a line in Turkey Creek right behind our creek line camp sites'; a 2022 review says 'Our lot was completed shaded right along the creek'. Turkey Creek (~25 m wide) runs 60-120 m south of the oval on imagery, with a lane along its north bank; the creek-site row itself wasn't located under the trees.
Pin 270 m off: the stored pin sits in a field beside US-52; the campground (oval and rows) centres on about 38.7033,-83.0817 (Google's pin 38.70340,-83.08217).
